bibl.title: Display of Erudition in the Periphery of the Graeco-Roman World. The Example of P. David 14.
bibl.seg: Aikaterini Koroli, Display of Erudition in the Periphery of the Graeco-Roman World. The Example of P. David 14.
bibl.note: New edition and philological analysis of P. David [Pap. Lugd.-Bat. XVII] 14 (= P. Stras. IV, 169 + P. Ross. Georg. II, 43). - 1. "In true friendship, actions speak louder than words" (ll. 3-17: ἐπίστασαι ὅτι ... ἐν τ]ῶι ἀνθρωπ[ί]νωι βίωι). - 2. Psychological problems (ll. 17-28: [ἐγὼ μ]ὲν δὴ ... ταῦτα ἦλθε). - 3. "Asking for help" (ll. 28-32: κἂν [ὁ] θεὸς ἐθέλῃ ... πόλιν). - Conclusions.
